name: 02360 · Plymouth, MA
findings: ZIP 02360 (Plymouth) has 211 nonprofit organizations. 88 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 80 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02360 (Plymouth) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 26 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
